messages.content: I reviewed both spa menus with my spouse. Please refresh the full five-night cost for Andaz and CIVANA, including every mandatory charge and breakfast for both of us. Also confirm the couples-treatment times and the terms of the Andaz package hold.

I’ll reconcile the room, mandatory fees, taxes, and five breakfasts first, then check the treatment calendars and the held-package conditions. Should I keep the February 20 through 25 dates and the Saturday Gateway Trailhead hike in the comparison?
Yes. We want the hike Saturday morning, so the spa should be Friday afternoon or Sunday. Airport transportation should be shown separately if neither resort includes it.

Andaz has reconfirmed its five-night breakfast package at $3,286.25 total: $2,600 room package, $250 mandatory destination fee, and $436.25 tax. Breakfast for two is included on all five mornings. The fee covers scheduled fitness classes and resort activities, but not airport transfers. Estimated airport and hike transportation remains $66 beyond the rides already included in the earlier airfare comparison.
And CIVANA? I want to be sure its lower room quote does not become more expensive once breakfast and fees are added.

CIVANA’s refreshed five-night room quote is $2,798.40. Its mandatory wellness fee and taxes add $259.40, bringing lodging to $3,057.80. Breakfast is not included; the current estimate for two people over five mornings is $420, so the comparable room-and-breakfast total is $3,477.80. Airport transportation is also excluded.
So Andaz is $191.55 less on the comparable hotel total. What treatment times are actually available?

Correct. Andaz still has two simultaneous 60-minute massages Friday at 3:30 p.m., totaling $573.40 with service charge. It also has paired appointments Sunday at 11:00 a.m. CIVANA can accommodate both of you together only Sunday at 2:45 p.m.; its Friday availability is split by nearly two hours. Its suitable couples booking plus the separately charged private soak keeps the previously calculated overall trip total at $5,001.20.
Please restate the complete expected totals on the same basis. Include airfare, the hotel, spa, and the hike transportation estimate.

Andaz is $4,871.65 for two: $946 airfare, $3,286.25 lodging with mandatory fee, tax, and five breakfasts, $573.40 for the paired massages, and $66 estimated hike transportation. CIVANA is $5,001.20 on the same trip basis, including its room charges, separately purchased breakfasts, treatment, private soak, and estimated transportation. Andaz is $129.55 less overall and preserves the Friday spa time before Saturday’s hike.
What exactly is being held at Andaz, and when does it expire? I do not want a nonrefundable package substituted at checkout.

The hold is for the breakfast-inclusive king-room package at the quoted $3,286.25 five-night total. It requires a $600.25 deposit, refundable if canceled by February 13 at 6:00 p.m. resort local time; after that deadline, the deposit becomes the room cancellation exposure. The hold expires tomorrow at 6:00 p.m. local time. No airport transfer is bundled, and the Friday massages have a separate 24-hour full-charge cancellation rule.
Book the held Andaz package and reserve both Friday 3:30 massages. Keep the Saturday hike plan. Use the refundable package exactly as quoted.

Andaz Scottsdale is booked for February 20 through 25 on the breakfast-inclusive refundable package. The five-night hotel total is $3,286.25, and the $600.25 deposit has been charged; cancellation is penalty-free through February 13 at 6:00 p.m. local time. Two Friday 3:30 p.m. massages are reserved for $573.40 and become fully chargeable inside 24 hours. The Saturday morning Gateway Trailhead hike remains in the itinerary, with $66 retained as the transportation estimate. The expected trip total for two is $4,871.65. CIVANA was not booked.
